# Corners Gallery (concept by Kerblabs, not affiliated)

> Contemporary art gallery and custom framing, Ithaca, New York. Facts from cornersgallery.com.

- Address: 903 Hanshaw Road, Suite 101A, Ithaca, NY 14850
- Phone: (607) 257-5756
- Email: Ariel@cornersgallery.com
- Gallery hours: Wednesday to Saturday, 11am to 4pm. No appointment needed to view the current exhibition.
- Custom framing: by appointment (preferred).
- Also: curatorial services, shop, Gallery at TRADE.

## Actions
- Book framing: call (607) 257-5756 or email Ariel@cornersgallery.com
